[#reference-commands]
== Command reference

Every command, taken from the registry. `ws-host command list` and `ws-host command show ID` say the same thing, and `ws-host help` is where the daily work is explained.

=== auth

[cols="3,1,2,5"]
|===
|Usage |Category |Where it runs |What it does

|`ws-host auth new FORGE [--host STRING] [--method STRING] [--own-app]`
|setup
|terminal, editor
|Sign in to GitHub, GitLab or Microsoft with a one-time code

|`ws-host auth set FORGE CLIENT_ID TENANT [--host STRING]`
|setup
|terminal, editor
|Tell ws-host which app signs a Microsoft account in, from an app registration of your own

|`ws-host auth status`
|read
|terminal, editor, mcp
|Say whether you are signed in to GitHub and GitLab

=== completion

[cols="3,1,2,5"]
|===
|Usage |Category |Where it runs |What it does

|`ws-host completion add SHELL`
|setup
|terminal, editor
|Set up Tab completion for ws-host in bash or fish

|`ws-host completion list KIND`
|read
|terminal, editor, mcp

=== config

[cols="3,1,2,5"]
|===
|Usage |Category |Where it runs |What it does

|`ws-host config check`
|check
|terminal, editor, mcp
|Say whether the files ws-host manages are as this ws-host would write them

|`ws-host config ensure`
|setup
|terminal
|Bring the files ws-host manages up to date, keeping a copy of each first

|`ws-host config show`
|read
|terminal, editor, mcp

|build
|terminal, editor, mcp

|===

=== kit

[cols="3,1,2,5"]
|===
|Usage |Category |Where it runs |What it does

|`ws-host kit add KIT`
|setup
|terminal
|Install a kit (uses sudo for packages, and says so first)

|`ws-host kit check [KIT]`
|check
|terminal, editor, mcp
|Ask the publishers of the tools that float what their newest releases are and how each would be checked; installs nothing

|`ws-host kit list`
|read
|terminal, editor, mcp
|List the kits and which are installed

|`ws-host kit show KIT`
|read
|terminal, editor, mcp
|Show what a kit installs on this machine

|`ws-host kit sync [KIT]`
|setup
|terminal
|Bring the tools that float with their newest release up to date, for every kit or for one

|===

=== onedrive

[cols="3,1,2,5"]
|===
|Usage |Category |Where it runs |What it does

|`ws-host onedrive add LOCAL REMOTE [--account STRING] [--replace]`
|setup
|terminal, editor
|Copy a local file or folder into OneDrive; nothing already there is replaced unless you say so

|`ws-host onedrive list [PATH] [--account STRING]`
|read
|terminal, editor, mcp
|List the files and folders in a OneDrive folder

|`ws-host onedrive show PATH [--account STRING]`
|read
|terminal, editor, mcp
|Show one file or folder in OneDrive

|`ws-host onedrive sync REMOTE LOCAL [--account STRING] [--replace]`
|setup
|terminal, editor
|Copy a OneDrive file or folder to this machine; a local file that differs is kept unless you say so

|===

=== provider

[cols="3,1,2,5"]
|===
|Usage |Category |Where it runs |What it does

|`ws-host provider add PATH`
|decision
|terminal, editor
|Enable a repository as a provider, so ws-host installs and runs what it declares

|`ws-host provider list`
|read
|terminal, editor, mcp
|List the providers you have enabled

|`ws-host provider remove PROVIDER`
|decision
|terminal, editor
|Stop using a provider (its programs stay until you prune them)

|`ws-host provider run PROVIDER [ARGV...] [--ensure STRING]`
|build
|terminal
|Run a command with one provider's programs first on PATH

|`ws-host provider show PROVIDER`
|read
|terminal, editor, mcp
|Show one provider, its launcher and the programs it pins

|===

=== release

[cols="3,1,2,5"]
|===
|Usage |Category |Where it runs |What it does

|`ws-host release build [--output PATH] [--skip-tests]`
|build
|terminal, editor, mcp
|Build a release: the wheel, the app tarball, the Workspaces Console and their checksums

|`ws-host release publish [--output PATH]`
|decision
|terminal, editor
|Tag this commit and publish the release to GitHub Releases, with your own gh sign-in

|===

=== repo

[cols="3,1,2,5"]
|===
|Usage |Category |Where it runs |What it does

|`ws-host repo add [REPO] [--all] [--trust]`
|setup
|terminal, editor
|Copy missing repositories to this machine

|`ws-host repo advance REPO [--clean]`
|decision
|terminal, editor
|Clean refresh: make a repository exactly what is on its shared branch, keeping what was only here in a backup branch

|`ws-host repo list`
|read
|terminal, editor, mcp
|List the repositories I know

|`ws-host repo set REPO [--trusted] [--untrusted]`
|decision
|terminal, editor
|Trust or stop trusting a repository's code

|`ws-host repo status [REPO] [--details] [--limit STRING] [--fetch]`
|read
|terminal, editor, mcp
|Show the state of one or all repositories; --details says what is incoming and what is only here, and why

|`ws-host repo sync [REPO] [--all]`
|setup
|terminal, editor
|Bring repositories up to date, never touching your work

=== toolchain

[cols="3,1,2,5"]
|===
|Usage |Category |Where it runs |What it does

|`ws-host toolchain ensure [NAME] [--provider PROVIDER] [--all]`
|setup
|terminal
|Install pinned programs from the lock, only from the lock

|`ws-host toolchain generate [PROVIDER] [--root PATH]`
|generate
|terminal, editor, mcp
|Write a provider's mise configuration and lock from its entries

|`ws-host toolchain list`
|read
|terminal, editor, mcp
|List the programs enabled providers pin and whether each is installed

|`ws-host toolchain remove [--unused]`
|setup
|terminal
|Remove stored programs no enabled provider pins

|`ws-host toolchain show NAME [--provider PROVIDER]`
|read
|terminal, editor, mcp
|Show one pinned program: version, where it is, what it provides and sets

|Usage |Category |Where it runs |What it does

|Usage |Category |Where it runs |What it does

=== (no noun: the repository-wide commands)

[cols="3,1,2,5"]
|===
|Usage |Category |Where it runs |What it does

|`ws-host check [SECTIONS...] [--suite SECTION]`
|check
|terminal, editor, mcp
|Run the checks of this repository

|`ws-host context [RESOURCE]`
|read
|terminal, editor, mcp
|Everything needed to get help with this machine, with secrets removed

|`ws-host doctor`
|check
|terminal, editor, mcp
|Check what ws-host needs and what is present

|`ws-host fresh [GENERATORS...]`
|check
|terminal, editor, mcp
|Prove the generated files are current

|`ws-host help [TOPIC]`
|read
|terminal, editor, mcp
|Learn how to do the daily work, one topic at a time

|`ws-host test`
|check
|terminal, editor, mcp
|Run this repository's tests

|`ws-host update [--check] [--cached] [--background] [--tools]`
|setup
|terminal, editor
|Bring everything up to date: ws-host, your repositories, the editor and what they need; only where nothing of yours is in the way; --check only looks

|===

A `decision` command is for a person: it is never offered over MCP, and the editor asks you in a dialog.
